items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: they would get me to record with them on all of their records

ctx.x: -- Bill Parker. And I would augment you know -- they would get me to record with them on all of their records, and they had a big hit at this time called Robin's Nest, written by Sir Charles. So Jacquet got J. J. to do another tune, told him to write a tune, and J. J. -- they wanted to follow up on "Robin's Nest" but they didn't ask Sir Charles to do the writing, they asked J. J. to do it. So we're in here and getting ready to record, and J. J. passed this music out, and we play it and it was just like "Robin's…

jumped up from the piano and called everybody a mother fucker and walked out. And until today we talk about it. He was with [Miles] about a week ago and he was still fuming. That happened 20 years ago, you know.
